description: The import line and JSX for one icon from `@keyline-icons/react`. Each style is its own entry point because they do not cover the same icons, and sharp is one segment further along: `@keyline-icons/react/sharp` and `/sharp/duotone`. The export is called the same thing either way.

corners.description: Corner treatment. `regular` is the rounded drawing and the default; `sharp` is the same icon with squared corners and butt caps.

name: get_react_usage
